business_id.title: Business Id
business_id.description: When this is provided then the business receives the report. If the report is related to a business, user in a business, or post in a business, the business id must be provided. If not, it will be assumed that the report is in regards to a relationship between users. Leave it out if the reported object is the business - e.g. if the post author is the business itself. Since we do not allow sending reports to a business when they are the one being reported.

object_id.title: Object Id
object_id.description: The object id concerned by the report.

object_type.description: The type of object that is being reported.
object_type.title: ReportObjectType

message.title: Message
message.description: The message to send with the report, if any.

items.title: ReportReasonType
items.description:
Enum for report reasons.

- `harmful_content` - Harmful Content
- `nudity_or_pornography` - Nudity
- `fraud_or_scam` - Fraud or Scam
- `sale_or_promotion_of_illegal_items` - Sale or Promotion of Illegal Items
- `spam` - Spam
- `misinformation_and_disinformation` - Misinformation and Disinformation
- `intellectual_property_violation` - Intellectual Property Violation
- `imminent_physical_harm` - Imminent Physical Harm
